environment.process: one isolated process, normal priority; no concurrent project CPU jobs

protocol.cached_state: Catalog/public fingerprint index only. Fresh request and memo for every timed invocation.
protocol.order: Six paired passes A/B/A/B/A/B; A forward, B reverse. Same inputs in every run.
protocol.prudent_fragility_policy: Declared before timing: at least two p95 above275ms (10% over) mark fragile; do not optimize or pick favorable reruns.
protocol.timed_scope: Warm recognition only; extraction/OCR and RequestPages construction excluded; per-request feature generation and lazy visual rendering included.
